summary: Crypto lending wallet operated by Izakaya Limited that entered a materially restricted state in September 2026 after Japan's Financial Services Agency published a warning concerning unregistered crypto-asset exchange business and the operator announced an end to service for Japan residents and Japanese nationals abroad. New registration and new lending are stopped for the affected population while a dedicated withdrawal process remains available. Public first-party materials still do not fully resolve lending counterparty, asset-ownership, custody-deployment, insurance, yield-source, regulatory-authorization, or completed customer-return questions.
what_happened: IZAKA-YA operates an account-based crypto wallet with lending, swap and transfer functions. During 2026 it advertised multiple temporary high-rate lending campaigns, which CYA records as issuer-advertised terms rather than verified realized returns. On 2026-08-24 the operator disclosed temporary transfer and withdrawal restrictions for some accounts and later said those reviews were not a universal platform-wide halt. Japan's Financial Services Agency published on 2026-09-01 that it had issued a warning concerning Izakaya Limited for unregistered crypto-asset exchange business. On 2026-09-17 IZAKA-YA announced that service would end for all customers residing in Japan and Japanese nationals living abroad, that new registration and new lending would stop for the affected population, that the Japanese-language site would close at the end of September, and that a dedicated withdrawal procedure would remain available until asset-return handling was completed.
uncertainty_notes: The company page supports Izakaya Limited and a Hong Kong operating address, while the public website terms state Cayman Islands governing law. The public terms are generic website terms rather than complete lending-product terms, and the logged-in lending flow appears to present separate contract content. Current first-party lending material also warns that crypto-lending principal is not guaranteed. Do not infer the exact lending counterparty, legal ownership transfer, rehypothecation/deployment mechanics, deposit insurance, licensing, universal repayment performance, or economic source and sustainability of promotional yields from the reviewed public pages.
notes: Promoted in Phase 10 from duplicate-clear candidate cya_candidate_000107. The December 2023 service-start month is preserved in narrative only because an exact launch day is not established. CYA now classifies the platform as limited because a material regional/nationality-scoped service termination is officially announced while the operator still presents a withdrawal process and has not announced a global shutdown. No insolvency, haircut, bankruptcy, universal withdrawal failure, or completed customer-recovery outcome is inferred.
